title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, the Ministry of Public Security, and the Ministry of Justice on Issuing the Opinions on Several Issues Concerning Regulating the Delivery for Execution of Criminals Sentenced to Imprisonment
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court  Supreme People's Procuratorate  Ministry of Public Security  Ministry of Justice

Notice on Issuing the "Opinions on Several Issues Concerning the Standardization of the Delivery of Execution of Criminal Offenders Sentenced to Custodial Penalties"

Fa Fa [2024] No. 15

The Higher People's Courts, People's Procuratorates, Public Security Departments (Bureaus), and Judicial Departments (Bureaus) of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Courts and Military Procuratorates of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region, the People's Procuratorate of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps, the Public Security Bureau, and the Judicial Bureau:

In order to fully implement Xi Jinping's Thought on the Rule of Law, deepen reforms in the political and legal fields, improve the working mechanism for the delivery of execution of criminal offenders sentenced to custodial penalties, and ensure the smooth progress of criminal proceedings, in accordance with the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the Prison Law of the People's Republic of China, and other relevant provisions, the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, the Ministry of Public Security, and the Ministry of Justice have formulated the "Opinions on Several Issues Concerning the Standardization of the Delivery of Execution of Criminal Offenders Sentenced to Custodial Penalties." The Opinions are hereby issued for your earnest implementation. Major problems encountered during implementation shall be reported level by level to the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, the Ministry of Public Security, and the Ministry of Justice.

December 19, 2024

Supreme People's Court  Supreme People's Procuratorate  Ministry of Public Security  Ministry of Justice

Opinions on Several Issues Concerning the Standardization of the Delivery of Execution of Criminal Offenders Sentenced to Custodial Penalties

In order to improve the working mechanism for the delivery of execution of criminal offenders sentenced to custodial penalties and ensure the smooth progress of criminal proceedings, these Opinions are formulated in accordance with the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the Prison Law of the People's Republic of China, and other relevant provisions, taking into account the actual situation of the delivery of execution of criminal offenders sentenced to custodial penalties.

Article 1 These Opinions govern the delivery of execution of offenders sentenced to death with a two-year reprieve, life imprisonment, fixed-term imprisonment, or criminal detention.

Article 2 The People's Court shall be responsible for serving the legal documents related to the execution of criminal penalties and, before the offender is delivered to the executing authority, making a decision on whether to grant temporary service of sentence outside prison.

The Public Security Authority shall be responsible for the pursuit, custody, and delivery of offenders.

The Prison Administration shall be responsible for receiving and imprisoning offenders; the Community Correction Institution shall be responsible for receiving and executing the penalties of offenders granted temporary service of sentence outside prison; the Detention Center shall be responsible for executing the penalties of offenders sentenced to criminal detention, and for executing the penalties on behalf of the prison for offenders sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment whose remaining sentence is less than three months before being delivered to the prison.

The People's Procuratorate shall exercise legal supervision over the delivery of execution of offenders' penalties.

The People's Court, People's Procuratorate, Public Security Authority, Detention Center, Prison, and Community Correction Institution shall, in the work of delivery of execution, divide responsibilities, cooperate with each other, standardize the lawful delivery of execution of offenders sentenced to custodial penalties, and effectively prevent the failure to detain offenders who should be detained by the Detention Center and the failure to imprison offenders who should be imprisoned by the Prison, thereby safeguarding judicial fairness and judicial authority.

Article 3 If the offender sentenced to death with a two-year reprieve, life imprisonment, fixed-term imprisonment, or criminal detention is in custody at the time of delivery for execution, the People's Court of first instance shall, within ten days after the judgment or ruling becomes effective, serve the judgment, ruling, copy of the indictment, copy of the private prosecution complaint, enforcement notice, and case closure registration form on the Detention Center. If the offender is not in custody at the time of delivery for execution, for cases investigated by the Public Security Authority, the People's Court of first instance shall, within ten days after the judgment or ruling becomes effective, serve the judgment, ruling, and decision on imprisonment for execution on the Public Security Authority that investigated the case, and within ten days after receiving notification from the Public Security Authority that the offender has been delivered to the Detention Center for custody, serve the relevant legal documents on the Detention Center; for private prosecution cases and duty crime cases, the People's Court of first instance shall serve the aforementioned legal documents on the Public Security Authority at the same level for processing.

The People's Court of first instance shall send a copy of the decision on imprisonment for execution as provided in the preceding paragraph to the People's Procuratorate at the same level.

Article 4 After receiving the judgment, ruling, and decision on imprisonment for execution served by the People's Court of first instance, the Public Security Authority shall, within ten days, deliver the offender not in custody to the Detention Center for custody.

After the Public Security Authority delivers the offender to the Detention Center for custody, it shall promptly notify the People's Court of first instance.

Article 5 If a defendant not in custody before trial who is sentenced to a custodial penalty is at large or missing, the Public Security Authority shall carry out pursuit based on the effective judgment, ruling, and decision on imprisonment for execution of the People's Court.

The Public Security Authority shall take effective measures such as issuing a wanted order, border control, and online pursuit as appropriate to the circumstances of the case. The effective judgment, ruling, and decision on imprisonment for execution of the offender not in custody before trial may serve as the basis for the Public Security Authority to issue a wanted order, handle border control procedures, and conduct online pursuit.

Article 6 If a defendant who is to be sentenced to a custodial penalty and is not in custody meets the conditions for arrest under the Criminal Procedure Law, the People's Court may decide to arrest the defendant before the judgment is pronounced and deliver the arrest decision to the Public Security Authority.

After receiving the People's Court's decision to arrest the defendant, the Public Security Authority shall, within five days, arrest the defendant and deliver him to the Detention Center for custody.

If the defendant in the preceding paragraph is at large or missing, the Public Security Authority shall be responsible for pursuit and promptly notify the People's Court.

Article 7 Where the Public Security Authority delivers a defendant or offender to the Detention Center for custody in accordance with Articles 4, 5, and 6 of these Opinions, the Detention Center shall accept the person for custody in accordance with the law.

If the Detention Center refuses to accept the aforementioned defendant or offender for custody, it shall provide a written explanation to the Public Security Authority and the People's Court, and send a copy to the People's Procuratorate. If the People's Procuratorate considers the reasons to be unfounded, it shall issue a written opinion to the Public Security Authority and the Detention Center respectively. When the Public Security Authority delivers the person again, the Detention Center shall accept him for custody.

Article 8 After receiving the legal documents for delivery of execution from the People's Court, the Detention Center shall, within one month, deliver offenders sentenced to death with a two-year reprieve, life imprisonment, or fixed-term imprisonment to the Prison for execution of the penalty; for offenders sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment whose remaining sentence before delivery to the Prison is less than three months, the Detention Center shall execute the penalty on behalf of the Prison; for offenders sentenced to criminal detention, the Detention Center shall execute the penalty.

After the Detention Center lawfully retains the offender to serve his sentence in the Detention Center or delivers him to the Prison, it shall, within one month, notify the People's Court of first instance in writing of the time and place of execution of the penalty.

Article 9 When the Prison receives an offender delivered by the Detention Center and the judgment, ruling, copy of the indictment, copy of the private prosecution complaint, enforcement notice, and case closure registration form for execution of the penalty, it shall accept the person for imprisonment in accordance with the law.

If the Prison refuses to accept a person for imprisonment due to discrepancies between the delivered offender and the legal documents, errors in the penalty record, or other reasons that may lead to wrongful imprisonment, it shall provide a written explanation to the Public Security Authority and the People's Court, and send a copy to the People's Procuratorate. If the People's Procuratorate considers the reasons to be unfounded, it shall issue a written opinion to the Public Security Authority and the Prison respectively. When the Public Security Authority delivers the person again, the Prison shall accept him for imprisonment.

For offenders suffering from illness, the Prison shall accept them for imprisonment in accordance with the law.

For offenders with foreign objects in their bodies, if medical reasons make removal inadvisable or if the offender himself is unwilling to have them removed and provides a diagnosis opinion and written statement, the Prison shall accept them for imprisonment in accordance with the law.

The Prison shall reasonably arrange the time and frequency of receiving offenders to ensure that offenders are imprisoned within the statutory time limit.

The Prison shall, every six months, notify the People's Court of first instance in writing of the information on the offenders received.

Article 10 During the trial of a criminal case by the People's Court and before the legal documents related to the execution of the criminal penalty are served on the Detention Center, if a defendant or offender who has been or may be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment, criminal detention, or life imprisonment may meet the circumstances for temporary service of sentence outside prison, and the defendant, offender, or his close relatives, guardians, or defense counsel submit an application for temporary service of sentence outside prison, or if the investigation authority, the Procuratorate, or the Detention Center submit a recommendation for temporary service of sentence outside prison, or if such circumstances are discovered in the course of trial work, the People's Court shall conduct a review in accordance with the law and promptly notify the applicant or recommending unit of the initiation of the review. The People's Court shall make a decision on whether to grant temporary service of sentence outside prison before the relevant legal documents are served on the Detention Center.

After the Detention Center receives the legal documents related to the execution of the criminal penalty and before the offender is delivered to the Prison, the work regarding temporary service of sentence outside prison shall be handled in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph. For offenders whose illness may be severe and who must immediately be released on medical parole, the People's Court shall immediately conduct a review and make a decision on whether to grant temporary service of sentence outside prison in accordance with the law.

Before the People's Court makes a decision on temporary service of sentence outside prison for an offender, it shall solicit the opinion of the People's Procuratorate at the same level in writing, and attach relevant materials such as the defendant's or offender's medical diagnosis, pregnancy examination, or appraisal of inability to care for oneself. After receiving the materials for solicitation of opinion from the People's Court, the People's Procuratorate shall, within ten days, provide a written response to the People's Court on whether it agrees to the offender's temporary service of sentence outside prison.

If the People's Court decides to grant temporary service of sentence outside prison to an offender, it shall send a copy of the decision on temporary service of sentence outside prison to the People's Procuratorate at the same level. If the People's Court decides not to grant temporary service of sentence outside prison to an offender, it shall notify the Detention Center or the Public Security Authority executing the recognizance pending trial or residential surveillance, as well as the applicant or recommending unit, of the decision not to grant temporary service of sentence outside prison, and send a copy to the People's Procuratorate at the same level.

Article 11 For offenders to whom the People's Court has decided not to grant temporary service of sentence outside prison, the Detention Center or Prison shall accept them for custody or imprisonment in accordance with the law.

Article 12 If the People's Court makes a decision on temporary service of sentence outside prison for an offender, it shall, within five days from the effective date of the decision, notify the Community Correction Institution of the place of execution, and within ten days, serve the decision on temporary service of sentence outside prison and send copies to the People's Procuratorate at the same level and the Public Security Authority of the place of execution. If the offender is in custody, the decision on temporary service of sentence outside prison shall be served on the Detention Center and the Community Correction Institution of the offender's place of execution; if the offender is not in custody, the decision on temporary service of sentence outside prison shall be served on the Public Security Authority executing the recognizance pending trial or residential surveillance and the Community Correction Institution of the offender's place of execution. If the offender has committed another crime during the community correction period, the People's Court shall also serve the decision on temporary service of sentence outside prison on the Prison or Detention Center where the offender originally served his sentence or which holds his files.

The Detention Center or the Public Security Authority executing the recognizance pending trial or residential surveillance shall, within ten days from the date of receiving the decision on temporary service of sentence outside prison, transfer the community correction recipient to the Community Correction Institution. The Community Correction Institution shall accept the community correction recipient in accordance with the law.

Article 13 The People's Court's organization of medical diagnosis, pregnancy examination, and appraisal of inability to care for oneself for defendants or offenders shall generally be completed within two months from the date of accepting the application, adopting the recommendation, or initiating ex officio, and in no case shall exceed three months. If an extension is necessary due to special circumstances, approval shall be sought from the higher-level People's Court.

Article 14 The costs for conducting medical diagnosis, pregnancy examination, and appraisal of inability to care for oneself for defendants or offenders shall be included in the annual case handling budget of the unit organizing the diagnosis, examination, or appraisal.

Article 15 For an offender who is the sole caregiver of a minor child and needs to be taken into custody for execution, the People's Court, People's Procuratorate, and Public Security Authority shall promptly coordinate with the Civil Affairs Department to resolve the issue of shelter and care for the offender's minor children, and shall deliver the offender to the Detention Center for custody in accordance with the provisions of Article 4 of these Opinions.

For an offender who is the sole supporter of a person unable to care for himself and needs to be taken into custody for execution, the provisions of the preceding paragraph shall be applied mutatis mutandis.

Article 16 Materials collected by the People's Court, People's Procuratorate, Public Security Authority, Detention Center, Prison, and Community Correction Institution concerning the physical health condition and disease diagnosis of defendants or offenders shall be attached to the case file; during the delivery of execution of the offender, copies of the aforementioned materials shall be transferred to the relevant authorities handling the case in the subsequent stage. Personal items not involved in the case brought by the offender shall be received in accordance with the law.

Where conditions permit, big data case-handling platforms should be fully utilized to promote real-time sharing of information on the delivery of execution of criminal penalties among relevant political and legal departments.

Article 17 Serious illness in the context of temporary service of sentence outside prison refers to the serious illnesses listed in the "Scope of Serious Illnesses for Medical Parole" attached to the "Provisions on Temporary Service of Sentence Outside Prison" (Si Fa Tong [2014] No. 112), and the relevant work standards and requirements in the "Opinions on Further Regulating the Work of Temporary Service of Sentence Outside Prison" (Si Fa Tong [2023] No. 24) shall be implemented.

Article 18 If a detainee in custody in a Detention Center or an offender in a Prison dies during the period of custody or imprisonment, the matter shall be handled respectively in accordance with documents such as the "Provisions on the Handling of Deaths of Detainees in Custody" issued by the Supreme People's Procuratorate, the Ministry of Public Security, and the Ministry of Civil Affairs, and the "Provisions on the Handling of Deaths of Offenders in Prisons" issued by the Supreme People's Procuratorate, the Ministry of Civil Affairs, and the Ministry of Justice, and the People's Procuratorate shall strengthen legal supervision in accordance with the law.

If a detainee in custody in a Detention Center or an offender in a Prison dies a natural death during the period of custody or imprisonment, or suffers injury or death due to suicide, self-harm, or self-injury, and the Detention Center, Prison, or their staff have fulfilled their duties, they shall not bear legal liability. If there are illegal or disciplinary acts such as dereliction of duty, abuse of power, or engaging in malpractices for personal gain, sanctions shall be imposed in accordance with laws and regulations; if a crime is constituted, criminal liability shall be pursued in accordance with the law.

Article 19 The People's Procuratorate shall fully exercise its functions of prison inspection, organize circuit inspections, public hearings, and carry out special legal supervision as needed, and supervise in accordance with the law the standardized conduct of the delivery of execution of offenders' penalties.

If the People's Procuratorate discovers illegal situations in the activities of the People's Court, Public Security Authority, Detention Center, Prison, or Community Correction Institution concerning the delivery of execution of offenders sentenced to custodial penalties, for minor cases, it shall raise corrective opinions orally and record them; for serious cases, it shall issue a notice of correction of illegality. The relevant unit shall promptly correct the situation for oral corrective opinions; for a written corrective notice, it shall, within fifteen days, notify the People's Procuratorate in writing of the corrective situation. If the relevant unit has objections to the corrective opinion of the People's Procuratorate, it may apply to the People's Procuratorate for review, and the People's Procuratorate shall promptly conduct a review and handle the matter in accordance with relevant provisions.

Article 20 In the work of delivery of execution of criminal penalties, if staff members of the People's Court, People's Procuratorate, Public Security Authority, Detention Center, Prison, Community Correction Institution, and other units fail to perform their duties in accordance with legal provisions and the provisions of these Opinions, engage in fraudulent activities, dereliction of duty, malpractices for personal gain, abuse of power, or other illegal or disciplinary acts, causing problems such as "difficulty in taking into custody" or "difficulty in sending to prison," resulting in offenders sentenced to custodial penalties who should be detained by the Detention Center not being detained, or offenders who should be imprisoned by the Prison being detained in the Detention Center beyond the statutory time limit, and thus failing to be delivered for execution in accordance with the law, the responsible persons and the heads of the unit to which they belong shall be held accountable in accordance with laws and regulations; if a crime is constituted, criminal liability shall be pursued in accordance with the law.

Article 21 These Opinions shall come into effect on January 1, 2025.

Where previous relevant provisions of the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, the Ministry of Public Security, and the Ministry of Justice are inconsistent with these Opinions, these Opinions shall prevail.
